summary: Paul Cuthbertson, 21, lifelong Eagle/Summit County local, died while skinning up to the Polar Star Inn (10th Mountain Division Hut Association backcountry lodge at 11,040 ft, west side of New York Mountain) to celebrate his 21st birthday with friends; left late Friday afternoon, apparently deviated from the usual route in snowy, windy conditions near 11,000 ft; friends went looking at first light Saturday morning; Vail Mountain Rescue and the Eagle County Sheriff's Office joined the search; Eagle County Coroner said cause pending autopsy.
location: Polar Star Inn, west side of New York Mountain
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue, Eagle County Sheriff's Office
